adjudication.scope: Chain and connector owners only; drivetrain_kit was published on 2026-09-15 and is not touched.
adjudication.preimage: Fresh 2026-09-16 production capture equals the 2026-09-08 final preimage restricted to chain and chain_link; effective bindings 31+9 -> 35+9.
adjudication.width: Internal width and the manufacturer designation are separate declarations; no width is inferred from speeds.
adjudication.connector: A connector declares its documented targets and reuse limit; a matching pitch never approves a chain.
adjudication.legacy: Published profile, platform and ecosystem readings are retained without becoming active compatibility.
adjudication.reviews: Independent review F1, F3 and F4 corrected; F2 concerned the kit member profile, published separately.
adjudication.released_client: f51f3777 decodes row_conditions and row_coherence; no scalar pairs and no strict order here.
